title.narrative: Proyecto de Modernizacin de la Gestin de los Recursos Hdricos
Water Resources Management Modernization Program

description.narrative: Contribuir para el uso eficiente de los RH y ecosistemas conexos en el Per, adoptando un enfoque participativo, de sostenibilidad y equidad, y el propsito es implantar planes e instrumentos de gestin de RH en las cuencas de Chira-Piura, Santa y Tacna.

To contribute to the efficient use of water resources and related ecosystems in Peru by adopting a participatory approach based on sustainability and equity; and its purpose is to implement water resource management plans and instruments in the Chira-Piura, Santa, and Tacna watersheds.
